situation:
You are the director of human resources at COPPER KETTLE RESTAURANT GROUP, a family-owned franchise group in its third generation that operates twenty-two restaurants. The president (judge) has asked you to recommend who should be placed in a new regional director role, and how that decision should be communicated to the general managers who run the group's restaurants.

Two years ago the group put a promise in writing to its general managers: every director-level opening would be filled from inside. The letter is in the handbook, and guests and staff alike hear the group describe itself as a place where people are promoted, not replaced. The group is now buying six restaurants in a neighboring state, a purchase still confidential until it signs.

The new state licenses franchises differently, and the purchase agreement requires a regional director in place within sixty days of closing who has held a multi-state franchise license. A general manager of eleven years, the group's strongest internal candidate, has run its two busiest restaurants and has never held that license. An outside candidate has held it for six years.

Promoting the general manager keeps the letter intact, but the group would have to hire outside licensing counsel it has not budgeted and accept that the sixty-day requirement may slip, which would reopen the purchase price. Hiring the outside candidate meets the date, but the general managers learn the promise in their handbook did not hold, and because the purchase is confidential they cannot be told why.

The president (judge) wants your recommendation on which candidate fills the role and what the group tells its general managers about the decision. You will present your recommendation to the president (judge) in the president's office. The president (judge) will greet you and ask to hear your ideas. After you have presented and answered the questions, the president (judge) will thank you for your work.
judgeCharacterization:

During the course of the role-play you are to ask the participant the following questions:
